_about: Qualifier rubric for the Lead Triage Crew (G2 D-2, D-5, D-13). It lives in this repo because G0's evaluation v1 contract has no rubric-registration tool; at start-up it is loaded into the layer's rubric store through G0's own seed loader under the namespaced id g2_lead_fit_v1, and every score is produced by G0's evaluation capability (DeterministicJudge, or ClaudeJudge with a key). The item scored is the Qualifier's LeadProfile as a flat object: role, relationship, company, pilot_stage, gap_at_least_6 ('yes'/'no'), size_band. Checks use G0's deterministic vocabulary (field_in, field_nonempty) so the rule engine and a model judge agree on what good looks like. The buyer definition is li-lead-gen-tools: docs/prds/07-decisions.md D-1 ('any leader sponsoring an AI pilot'), src/tools/shared.ts DECISION_ROLES, src/tools/stalled-pilot-diagnostic.ts leadGrade.conditions.

rubrics.title: Lead fit against the Stalled-Pilot Diagnostic buyer (an AI pilot sponsor)
rubrics.source: li-lead-gen-tools D-1 + shared.ts DECISION_ROLES + stalled-pilot-diagnostic.ts leadGrade; G2 D-5

criteria.description: The person is an executive sponsor or the pilot lead (li-lead-gen-tools DECISION_ROLES); a team member or outside advisor cannot buy.
The person is a buyer at an operating company: not a vendor selling into Lab Intelligence's audience, not a student or researcher, not an outside advisor acting for someone else.
The company is identified: a directory record was found, or the contact already carried a complete profile.
The pilot is in one of the stalled stages the diagnostic grades as hot: running with no decision, finished but not rolled out, or rolled out with low use.
At least one diagnostic category (people, process, technology) has a gap of 6 or more out of 9.
The company has 51 or more employees, so a pilot has an organization around it.
